requests.prompt:
Generate TWO separate static textured 3D game assets for CORO SOLTO, a classic browser FPS set in an ordinary Brazilian public emergency clinic (UPA). Create an asset pack only if it gives two independently downloadable self-contained GLB files, one object per GLB. Start with these two pilots, not a room or scene. Coherent restrained realistic game style, off-white paint, silver-gray steel and muted blue-green vinyl, slight maintained edge wear. No people, brands, readable text, blood, gore or floor slabs. Compact game-ready geometry and opaque materials, preserve real open gaps; no baked lighting. Y up and centered ground pivots.

1. upa_maca: one empty transport stretcher, narrow off-white vinyl mattress, small raised pillow at head, muted pale blue pad, silver-gray tubular chassis, two distinct side safety rails, four black caster wheels and visible lower support shelf. Width0.90m, total height1.15m, length2.00m along Z; mattress top1.00m; head-Z, feet+Z. Gaps underneath remain open.

2. upa_longarina: one fully assembled public-clinic waiting bench with EXACTLY THREE individual blue-green seats and three distinct backs on one silver-gray beam, two sturdy support legs with black feet, slim outer armrests, no luxury upholstery. Width2.20m along X, overall back height0.85m, depth0.55m, seat height0.45m. Seats face+Z. The three seats stay separate and the space under the beam is open.

Generate the actual 3D assets now, not just text or a reference image. Return the asset IDs and independent GLB download options.

Generate the next SEVEN independent static textured GLB props for the same UPA Clinic Props collection, matching the already generated stretcher and three-seat bench: restrained realistic ordinary Brazilian public clinic, off-white steel, silver-gray metal, muted blue-green accents, slight maintained wear. One assembled object per independently downloadable GLB, not a room. Real open gaps, opaque materials, compact geometry, Y up and centered ground pivots. No people, brands, readable text, blood, gore or floor slabs.

1. upa_monitor: unbranded off-white vital-signs ECG monitor on compact wheeled cart, dark screen with a simple muted green ECG trace as surface texture, tiny unreadable indicators, few physical buttons, silver vertical support and small shelf, four distinct black casters. Total0.50m wide,1.50m high,0.48m deep. Screen faces+Z. No trailing cables or extra instruments.

2. upa_soro: slender silver-gray adjustable hospital IV pole, two clearly formed top hooks, one small pale opaque IV bag and a short attached tube ending above floor, compact five-spoke caster base with small black wheels. Height1.90m, base0.45x0.45m. Gaps around spokes remain open, no solid pedestal.

3. upa_oxigenio: exactly one muted hospital-green portable oxygen cylinder secured to a small two-wheel trolley, silver valve, compact regulator, small round gauge, gray frame, retaining strap, two black wheels, stable base. Width0.40m,height1.25m,depth0.40m. No loose hoses or labels.

4. upa_biombo: one assembled freestanding three-panel privacy screen, three connected opaque pale mint-green washable fabric rectangles, silver tubular frame, shallow gentle zigzag while almost straight, short support feet with small black casters. Height1.80m, screen length2.20m alongZ, footprint acrossX at most0.40m. Panels face+/-X. Fabric continuous for real visual cover.

5. upa_cadeira_rodas: one empty unfolded standard manual wheelchair, silver tubular folding frame, dark blue washable seat and back, two distinct large round black rear wheels with push rims, two small front casters, two armrests, two rear push handles, two separate forward footrests. Width0.68m,height0.95m,depth1.00m includingfootrests. Faces+Z; bigwheels left/rightX. Preserve real open spaces and round wheels.

6. upa_armario: one tall closed utilitarian medicine/supply cabinet, off-white painted steel, two solid hinged front doors, recessed silver handles, small lock, slim muted-green upper fascia, recessed dark toe kick. Width1.20m,height2.40m,depth0.60m; frontdoors+Z. No glass or displayed contents.

7. upa_balcao: one straight institutional reception counter, off-white laminate front with subtle pale mint horizontal accent, warm gray-beige countertop with smalloverhang, recessed dark toe kick, three practical staff-side work sections with closed storage. Width6.20m alongX,height1.20m,depth1.10m. Solid publicfront+Z,staffside-Z. Nothing oncountertop; noupper glass partition or clutter.

Generate the actual 3D assets as seven separate GLBs, not just images or prose. Return independent downloads and asset IDs.

Generate ONE replacement independent GLB for upa_monitor, same off-white and silver ordinary Brazilian UPA clinic style as this project. The previous generated ECG cart is defective: its entire middle vertical support is absent, leaving a monitor floating above a detached caster base. This replacement MUST be a physically connected assembled object: a thick clearly visible continuous silver steel vertical column at least 5 cm wide running from the center of the four-caster base all the way to a solid small upper tray supporting the ECG monitor. Show the entire connected column unobstructed. No floating parts. One vital-signs monitor, dark screen with restrained green ECG trace and unreadable indicators, several molded buttons; off-white casing. Four black wheels on open short base arms, upper tray and central rigid column only, no cables, no extra instruments. Overall height 1.50 m, base width about 0.50 m and depth about 0.48 m. Screen faces +Z, Y up, ground-center pivot, opaque PBR, no brands/readable text/people/blood/floor slab. Generate real static textured 3D GLB with actual continuous support geometry, not merely a preview.

Generate one replacement static 3D GLB reception counter MODULE for the same Brazilian UPA clinic. Earlier counter had disconnected floating cubes and fragments on the staff side. This new asset must be a simple fully connected closed rectangular cabinet counter, with solid continuous panels on ALL four vertical sides and one continuous flat countertop. Absolutely no floating fragments, no inside workstations, no open rear cavities, no loose blocks or furniture, no accessories. We will place two identical modules side by side in the game; one module is 3.10 m wide along X, 1.20 m high, 1.00 m deep along Z. Long low silhouette width more than 2.5 times height. Off-white laminate public front facing +Z, one slim pale mint horizontal accent, light warm-gray countertop slight overhang, closed plain off-white back facing -Z, narrow recessed dark toe kick physically joined to cabinet. Restrained realistic utilitarian public clinic, slight maintained edge wear, opaque PBR textures, no glass/people/brands/readable text/floor slab, Y-up, ground-center pivot. Real GLB geometry must show the same coherent closed object from front, back, sides and underneath. Generate actual 3D, not just image.
